name: omasheets
description: Agentic native spreadsheet work with verified human review

interface.shortDescription: Understand, revise, and safely improve live workbooks.
interface.longDescription: OmaSheets gives Codex selection-aware workbook context, sealed observations, explainable purpose-grouped plans, verified semantic diffs, iterative revision, and explicit local approval without agent publication authority.
interface.defaultPrompt: Start from omasheets://agent and help with my selected workbook. Inspect the evidence you need, clarify material ambiguity, and explain any verified proposal. Never publish workbook bytes.
